title: Wonderful!
text: Wonderful!. These are just wonderful Dishcloths. They are like the old-fashioned terry ones that absorb well they are thick and soft. Very good quality and also have a Handle sewn in the middle of one side so you can hang it on a hook. The size is nice and big. Great towel !!!

product_metadata.title: Kitchen Dish Towels Pack of 6, Absorbent Kitchen Hand Towels, Cotton Tea Towels 15x26 Inches (Black)
features: Great value pack for easy storage - each set includes 6 kitchen towels and measures 16" x 26" for everyday use. Hanging loop for easy storage

Strong enough for any job - Commercial grade premium, luxuriously soft kitchen quick-drying towels are available for all your kitchen needs. Great for drying glassware, cookware and anything outside the kitchen
SUPER ABSORBENT - High quality cotton terry cloth creates firmness, these 100% natural cotton dish towels for kitchen are very durable yet soft enough to gently care for your hands
MULTIPLE USES - Our kitchen hand towels are versatile, not only for kitchens, but also for cleaning bathrooms, cars, windows, and more
EASY CARE: Cotton dish towels are machine washable and tumble dry; low lint and shrinkage; withstands multiple washes; for best results, wash on a gentle cycle in cold water, then tumble dry
description: Glynniss offers a wide variety of cotton dish towels and washcloths; suitable for any theme, occasion and season. Are you running a business and need a professional set of dish towels? With the wide variety of colors and designs on offer, you're sure to find the perfect color and style combination to suit your kitchen needs! Towels are made from 100% cotton fabric and are machine washable. Simply wash gently in cold water and tumble dry on low, do not bleach or tumble dry through a hot dryer. The assortment of color wipe sets are available in a variety of colors to match your kitchen, while providing easy-absorbing and fast-drying towels. These medium weight and highly absorbent towels are effective and efficient for any task. These tea towels dry quickly too and look great!
